teaching.en: Rae said a storm had closed the outdoor training field on Wednesday and told Omar to find an indoor alternative. Omar reported that Hall One was available on Friday at ten and told Nina to move the training equipment. Nina said she could move it and sent the updated schedule. Rae then confirmed Friday at ten in Hall One. Omar secures the hall, Nina moves the equipment, and Rae closes the change. This cancellation-and-relocation chain preserves all three speakers, times and required actions without relying on overlapping availability.

La cadena conserva hablantes, tiempos y acciones mediante cancelación y traslado, no mediante disponibilidades superpuestas.
